calendar.title: Do I even need a visa? 61 countries don't.
calendar.title_cn: 我需要签证吗？61 个国家不需要
calendar.pain: Uncertain which visa type applies and how long it takes.
calendar.pain_cn: 不确定适用哪种签证类型，也不清楚需要多长时间。
calendar.solution: Good news first: citizens of 61 countries can enter Hainan visa-free for up to 30 days — for tourism, business, family visits, medical treatment, exhibitions and sports (but not paid work or study). You simply show your ordinary passport at any of Hainan's open ports; there's no visa application, no fee and no waiting. Your 30-day countdown starts at 00:00 on the day after you land, and you must stay within Hainan Province the whole time. If you're coming to work, study or join family, you'll need a Z, X1/X2 or Q1/Q2 visa instead — tell Ouwen your purpose and we'll pick the right type and handle the paperwork for you.
calendar.solution_cn: 先说好消息：61 国公民可免签入境海南，最长停留 30 天——适用于旅游、商贸、探亲、就医、会展和体育竞技（不含有偿工作与学习）。你只需持普通护照从海南任一对外开放口岸入境，无需申请签证、没有费用、也无需等待。30 天停留期自入境次日 0 时起算，且须全程停留在海南省境内。如果你来工作、学习或家庭团聚，则需分别办理 Z、X1/X2 或 Q1/Q2 签证——告诉欧闻你的来琼目的，我们会帮你选定合适类型并代办全部手续。

highlights.en: Allowed purposes: tourism, business, visits, family, medical treatment, exhibitions, sports competitions (work and study excluded).

highlights.en: Activity is limited to Hainan Province, up to 30 days.
highlights.cn: 活动范围仅限于海南省行政区域，停留不超过 30 天。

facts.cn: 61 个免签国家（截至 2026 年 8 月）

calendar.title: The Z-visa document checklist, decoded.
calendar.title_cn: Z 字签证材料清单，逐条拆解
calendar.pain: Application materials feel complicated and unclear.
calendar.pain_cn: 申请材料繁琐、要求不清晰。
calendar.solution: Coming to work? Hainan's 'one-window' service lets you apply for your work permit and residence permit together, in a single visit — no shuttling between different offices. You'll generally need your passport, a signed job offer or contract, your degree and professional certificates (notarised and legalised if issued abroad), a recent health check, and a no-criminal-record certificate from your home country. Ouwen turns all of this into a plain-English checklist, reviews every document before you submit so nothing gets rejected, and tracks your application until both permits are in your hand.
calendar.solution_cn: 来工作？海南「一窗通办」让你把工作许可和居留许可一起申请，一次办结——不用在不同部门之间来回跑。你通常需要准备：护照、已签署的工作录用通知或劳动合同、学历与职业资格证书（境外签发的须经公证与领事认证）、近期体检证明，以及原籍国的无犯罪记录证明。欧闻会把这一切整理成一份纯英文清单，在你提交前逐项核对避免被退回，并全程跟踪直到两个许可都拿到手。

highlights.en: Hainan runs a 'one-window service' — work permit and residence permit are processed together in a single application.
highlights.cn: 海南实行「一窗通办」——工作许可与居留许可一次性合并办理。

highlights.en: A standardised document checklist removes guesswork from the Z-visa application.
highlights.cn: 标准化材料清单，让 Z 字签证申请不再靠猜。

highlights.en: Progress is tracked end-to-end so you always know the current status.
highlights.cn: 全程跟踪进度，随时掌握办理状态。

facts.cn: 工作许可 + 居留许可一窗办理

tip.en: Prepare scanned colour copies of your passport, degree certificate (authenticated), and a clean criminal record check before starting — these are the most common delay points.
tip.cn: 提前备好护照彩色扫描件、学历证书（认证件）和无犯罪记录证明——这三样是最常见的拖进度环节。

calendar.title: Where do I stay before I find 'home'?
calendar.title_cn: 在找到「家」之前，我住哪里？
calendar.pain: Hard to find short/long-term housing suited to foreigners from abroad.
calendar.pain_cn: 人在境外，很难找到适合外国人的短期/长期住房。
calendar.solution: Before you've found a long-term home, Ouwen's 'Arrival Package' removes the stress of your first nights in Hainan. We arrange an airport pickup, book you into partner hotels or serviced apartments that are foreigner-friendly (English-speaking front desk, flexible short stays), and stock your room with the essentials — a local SIM card, a transport card, and basic living supplies. From there we help you bridge into longer-term housing without ever feeling lost or overcharged.
calendar.solution_cn: 在你找到长期住所之前，欧闻「安心抵达套餐」帮你化解初到海南的头几晚焦虑。我们安排接机、预订对外籍人士友好的合作酒店或酒店式公寓（前台讲英文、支持灵活短住），并为房间备齐必需品——本地手机卡、交通卡和基本生活用品。之后我们再帮你无缝过渡到长期住房，让你始终不会感到迷茫或被多收费。

highlights.en: Transitional housing at partner hotels and serviced apartments lets you settle in while you hunt for a long-term home.

calendar.title: Pre-load e-CNY before you even land.
calendar.title_cn: 落地前就预充值数字人民币
calendar.pain: Worried about paying on arrival; unsure how to exchange money or open accounts.
calendar.pain_cn: 担心抵达时无法支付；不确定如何兑换货币或开户。
calendar.solution: You can pay like a local before you even land. China's digital yuan (e-CNY) wallet can be pre-loaded from abroad: people in 210+ countries can register with just a phone number, open an anonymous wallet, and top up without needing a Chinese bank card. That means on day one you already have a working payment method for shops, transport and restaurants. Ouwen walks you through downloading the e-CNY app, verifying your identity, and pre-loading funds so you land ready to spend.
calendar.solution_cn: 你还没落地就能像本地人一样支付。中国的数字人民币（e-CNY）钱包支持境外预充值：210 多个国家的人只需手机号即可注册、开设匿名钱包、充值，无需境内银行卡。这意味着你第一天就有了可用于商店、交通和餐厅的支付方式。欧闻带你一步步下载 e-CNY APP、完成实名认证并预充值，让你落地即可消费。

highlights.en: You can pre-charge an e-CNY (digital yuan) wallet from abroad before you land.
highlights.cn: 可在境外提前预充值数字人民币（e-CNY）钱包，落地即用。

highlights.en: Registration works with a foreign phone number — 210+ countries are supported.

calendar.title: Visa, Mastercard, JCB — now work on WeChat & Alipay.
calendar.title_cn: Visa、Mastercard、JCB——微信支付宝都能用了
calendar.pain: Fear that only Chinese bank cards are accepted.
calendar.pain_cn: 担心只接受中国银行卡。
calendar.solution: Don't worry about carrying cash — China's two big payment apps now accept foreign cards. WeChat Pay and Alipay both support Visa, Mastercard, JCB, American Express and Discover, and you can register and link your card using a foreign phone number. You'll also get a healthy free spending quota before any small fee applies to large payments. Ouwen helps you download the app, link your card, and test a payment so you're confident before your first purchase.
calendar.solution_cn: 别担心带现金——中国两大支付 APP 现在都支持境外卡。微信支付和支付宝均支持 Visa、Mastercard、JCB、美国运通和 Discover，且可用境外手机号注册并绑定银行卡。大额支付产生少量手续费之前，你还能享受一笔不错的免手续费额度。欧闻帮你下载 APP、绑定银行卡并试付一笔，让你在第一次消费前就心里有底。

source.name: PBOC — Payment Guide for Foreigners

highlights.en: WeChat Pay and Alipay accept international cards: Visa, Mastercard, JCB, Amex and Discover.
highlights.cn: 微信支付与支付宝支持 Visa、Mastercard、JCB、Amex、Discover 国际卡。

highlights.en: Foreign phone numbers are fully supported for account binding.
highlights.cn: 完全支持境外手机号绑定。

tip.cn: 起飞前先绑卡并做一笔小额测试——境外卡被拒大多是发卡行的风控拦截，一通电话即可解除。

calendar.title: The language barrier starts before takeoff.
calendar.title_cn: 语言障碍，从起飞前就开始了
calendar.pain: Worried about communicating in Chinese upon arrival.
calendar.pain_cn: 担心抵达后无法用中文沟通。
calendar.solution: You won't be stranded by the language. Hainan's government hotline 12345 offers service in English, Russian, Japanese and Korean, and bilingual (Chinese/English) signage is mandatory at airports and major transport hubs across the province. Many key apps also have English interfaces. Ouwen gives you a quick-start language card — key phrases, the hotline number, and which apps to switch to English — so your first day isn't lost in translation.
calendar.solution_cn: 你不会被语言困住。海南政务服务热线 12345 提供英、俄、日、韩四种语言服务，全省机场和主要交通枢纽强制设置中英双语标识，许多常用 APP 也有英文界面。欧闻送你一张速成语言卡——常用短语、热线号码、以及哪些 APP 可切换英文界面——让你的第一天不再迷失在语言里。

highlights.en: The 12345 government service hotline answers in English, Russian, Japanese and Korean.
highlights.cn: 12345 政务服务热线提供英、俄、日、韩四种外语服务。

highlights.en: Bilingual signage is mandated at airports and major transport hubs.
highlights.cn: 机场及主要交通枢纽强制设置双语标识。

highlights.en: The NIA also runs a 24-hour hotline (+86 12367) with English service.
highlights.cn: 国家移民管理局另设 24 小时热线（+86 12367），含英语服务。

tip.en: Save both numbers in your phone before departure — 12345 for daily life, 12367 for immigration/visa questions.
tip.cn: 出发前把这两个号码存进手机——12345 管日常生活，12367 管出入境/签证问题。

official_links.label_cn: 国家移民管理局服务热线

calendar.title: Three airports, direct from everywhere.
calendar.title_cn: 三大机场，全球直飞
calendar.pain: Unfamiliar with entry ports and transport.
calendar.pain_cn: 不熟悉入境口岸和交通方式。
calendar.solution: Getting to Hainan is easy from almost anywhere. The island has three international airports — Haikou Meilan, Sanya Phoenix and Bo'ao — with direct and connecting flights from across Asia, Europe and beyond. If you're routing through Hong Kong or Macau, many nationalities also qualify for a 144-hour visa-free transit, and 15-day visa-free entry applies to foreign cruise-tour groups arriving at Hainan's cruise ports. Ouwen helps you compare routes, understand transit rules, and pick the entry port closest to where you'll stay.
calendar.solution_cn: 从几乎任何地方来海南都很方便。岛上拥有三座国际机场——海口美兰、三亚凤凰和博鳌——覆盖亚洲、欧洲等地的直飞与中转航线。若你经香港或澳门中转，许多国籍还可享受 144 小时过境免签；外国邮轮旅游团经海南邮轮口岸入境可享 15 天免签。欧闻帮你对比航线、搞懂过境规则，并挑选离你住宿地最近的入境口岸。

highlights.en: Three international airports: Haikou Meilan, Sanya Phoenix and Qionghai Bo'ao.
highlights.cn: 三大国际机场：海口美兰、三亚凤凰、琼海博鳌。

highlights.en: 144-hour visa-free transit via Hong Kong / Macau gives another flexible entry route.
highlights.cn: 经香港/澳门 144 小时过境免签，提供另一条灵活的入境路线。

highlights.en: 15-day visa-free entry is available for cruise-ship tour groups.
highlights.cn: 邮轮旅游团可享 15 天免签入境。

facts.cn: 经港/澳 144 小时过境免签

tip.en: If there is no direct flight from your city, fly via Hong Kong or Macau — both connect to Hainan on short hops and preserve the visa-free route.
tip.cn: 若所在城市无直飞，可经香港或澳门中转——两地到海南航程短，且不破坏免签路线。

calendar.title: Register your stay within 24 hours — or get fined.
calendar.title_cn: 24 小时内登记住宿，否则罚款
calendar.pain: Mandatory temporary residence registration is confusing and time-sensitive.
calendar.pain_cn: 临时住宿登记是强制的，流程复杂且时效性强。
calendar.solution: By law, every foreigner must register their temporary residence within 24 hours of arriving at where they'll stay — miss it and you can be fined. If you're in a hotel, the hotel usually does this for you automatically; if you're in a rented apartment, it's on you to register at the local police station. Ouwen's 'Maker Ambassador' walks with you to the station, translates the forms, and gets it done in one visit — so you start your stay fully compliant.
calendar.solution_cn: 法律规定，每位外籍人士须在抵达住宿地后 24 小时内办理临时住宿登记——逾期可能被罚款。住酒店通常由酒店自动代办；住出租屋则需你本人到辖区派出所登记。欧闻「创客业务员」陪你到派出所、翻译表格、一次办结——让你从一开始就完全合规。

highlights.en: Foreigners must register their temporary residence within 24 hours of arrival in China.
highlights.cn: 外国人在华须在抵达后 24 小时内办理临时住宿登记。

highlights.en: Staying in a hotel auto-registers you; renting a home means you must register at the local police station yourself.
highlights.cn: 住酒店会自动登记；租房则需本人到属地派出所登记。

highlights.en: Ouwen's Maker Ambassador escorts you to the station with translation — done in one visit.
highlights.cn: 欧闻「安家大使」陪同前往，全程翻译，一次办结。

tip.en: Keep your hotel receipt or rental contract handy — it is the proof of address the police station will ask for.
tip.cn: 随身带好酒店凭证或租赁合同——这是派出所登记时要核对的住址证明。

calendar.title: Open a bank account without the headache.
calendar.title_cn: 无痛开设银行账户
calendar.pain: Local bank account requires work proof, address proof — a maze.
calendar.pain_cn: 本地开户需工作证明、地址证明，像走迷宫。
calendar.solution: Opening a local bank account is the gateway to seamless payments, rent and salary. Hainan banks can open an EF (Exchange/Foreign) account for eligible foreigners, often with priority service through partner banks. You'll typically need your passport, residence permit or work permit, and proof of address. Ouwen's 'Life Concierge' prepares your document pack, books an appointment at a partner branch, and escorts you through the whole process — including linking your new account to your e-CNY wallet.
calendar.solution_cn: 开设本地银行账户是顺畅支付、交房租和领工资的门户。海南的银行可为符合条件的外籍人士开立 EF（外汇）账户，合作银行通常提供优先服务。你通常需要护照、居留许可或工作许可、以及地址证明。欧闻「生活管家」帮你备齐材料、预约合作网点、全程陪同办理——并帮你把新账户绑定到数字人民币钱包。

source.name: PBOC Hainan Branch — EF Account
source.name_cn: 人民银行海南分行 — EF 账户

highlights.en: Opening a local bank account usually needs work proof and address proof — the classic maze.
highlights.cn: 本地开户通常需要工作证明与住址证明——典型的迷宫流程。

highlights.en: Hainan runs an 'EF Account' (easy/fast account) scheme for foreigners with simplified documents.
highlights.cn: 海南推出「EF 账户」（便捷账户）制度，外国人开户材料更简化。

highlights.en: Ouwen's Life Concierge prepares documents and escorts you to partner banks for priority opening + a linked e-CNY wallet.

facts.cn: EF 账户 = 简化开户

tip.en: Bring your passport, residence permit and a Chinese phone number — those three unlock most bank counters.
tip.cn: 带齐护照、居留许可和一个中国手机号——这三样能解锁大多数银行柜台。

calendar.title_cn: 手机卡与宽带——英文讲解

calendar.pain_cn: 看不懂手机/宽带套餐与合同条款。

Ouwen helps you compare plans, choose the right data and broadband package for your usage, explain every term in English, and complete the setup — SIM activation, router installation and Wi-Fi configuration included.
calendar.solution_cn: 只要有人讲解，在中国上网其实很简单。本地运营商提供预付费手机卡和宽带套餐，但合同和细则都是中文。欧闻帮你对比套餐、按你的使用习惯选择合适的流量与宽带组合、用英文逐条讲解条款，并完成全部开通——包括手机卡激活、路由器安装和 Wi-Fi 配置。

calendar.title: The perks you're missing: duty-free, 15% tax, startup cash.
calendar.title_cn: 你错过的福利：免税、15% 税率、创业补贴
calendar.pain: Half-knowing Hainan's special policies, unable to use them.
calendar.pain_cn: 对海南特殊政策一知半解，无法真正用起来。
calendar.solution: Hainan is stacked with incentives most newcomers never claim: offshore duty-free shopping, a 15% personal and corporate income-tax rate for qualifying people and businesses, and startup cash for eligible founders. The hard part is knowing which ones apply to you and how to actually claim them. Ouwen's 'Policy Expert' service gives you an online knowledge base, regular offline salons, and a 1-on-1 session to map every incentive you qualify for into a simple action list.
calendar.solution_cn: 海南堆满了大多数新来者从未申领的优惠：离岛免税购物、符合条件者与企业的 15% 个税/企业所得税优惠税率、以及符合条件的创业者创业补贴。难的是弄清哪些适合你、又该如何真正申领。欧闻「政策专家」服务提供线上知识库、定期线下沙龙，以及一对一梳理你符合条件的所有优惠并整理成可执行清单。

highlights.en: Hainan's special incentives include duty-free shopping, a 15% tax cap and startup subsidies.
highlights.cn: 海南特殊政策含免税购物、15% 税率封顶与创业补贴。

highlights.en: Most people only half-know these — and almost no one uses them all.
highlights.cn: 多数人只知其一、鲜有人全用上。

highlights.en: Ouwen's Policy Expert gives you a 1-on-1 reading of the incentives that apply to YOUR situation.
highlights.cn: 欧闻「政策专家」一对一解读适合你的政策组合。

facts.cn: 三大福利：免税 / 15% 税率 / 补贴

tip.en: Don't self-diagnose eligibility from news headlines — one short consult often reveals a subsidy you were missing.
tip.cn: 别只靠新闻标题判断自己够不够格——一次简短咨询常能挖出你漏掉的补贴。

calendar.title: Getting around Hainan: a 5-minute crash course.
calendar.title_cn: 海南出行：5 分钟速成
calendar.pain: Unfamiliar with buses, ride-hailing, and driving rules.
calendar.pain_cn: 不熟悉公交、网约车与驾驶规则。
calendar.solution: Getting around Hainan is cheap and easy once you know the tools. Ride-hailing apps like Didi have English support, buses cover every city, and the high-speed rail links the whole island. If you want to drive, many nationalities can convert to a Chinese temporary driving permit. calendar.solution_cn: 只要会用工具，在海南出行便宜又方便。滴滴等网约车 APP 支持英文，公交覆盖每座城市，环岛高铁连接全岛。如果你想开车，许多国籍可换领中国临时驾驶许可。欧闻给你 5 分钟速成：该装哪些 APP、如何支付交通费、如何办理临时驾照，以及我们的合作租车推荐。

highlights.en: A 5-minute crash course covers buses, ride-hailing and driving rules.
highlights.cn: 5 分钟速成课讲清公交、网约车与驾车规则。

highlights.en: Temporary driving-permit assistance lets you hit the road fast with a foreign license.
highlights.cn: 协助办理临时驾驶许可，外国驾照也能快速上路。

highlights.en: Partner car-rental recommendations save you from tourist-price traps.
highlights.cn: 合作租车推荐，避开游客价陷阱。

tip.en: Install a local ride-hailing app and link your international card before you arrive — hailing a car gets far easier.
tip.cn: 落地前装好本地打车 App 并绑好国际卡——叫车会顺手很多。

calendar.title: Renting as a foreigner: avoid the 7 traps.
calendar.title_cn: 外国人租房：避开 7 个坑
calendar.pain: Opaque rental market, risk of fake landlords and deposit disputes.
calendar.pain_cn: 租房市场不透明，有假房东与押金纠纷风险。
calendar.solution: Renting in Hainan is safe if you avoid the common traps: fake landlords, unverified listings, and deposit disputes. Always verify the property deed and the landlord's identity, sign a written contract, and record exactly what the deposit covers. Ouwen's 'Settling Advisor' works only with licensed agents, checks the property deed against the owner's ID, and walks you through every clause of the contract before you sign — so your deposit is protected.
calendar.solution_cn: 在海南租房只要避开常见陷阱就很安全：假房东、未核实的房源、押金纠纷。务必核实房产证与房东身份、签书面合同、并明确押金的覆盖范围。欧闻「安居顾问」只对接持牌中介、核对房产证与房东身份证、并在你签约前逐条讲解合同——让你的押金有保障。

highlights.en: 7 common rental traps: fake landlords, deposit disputes, opaque clauses.
highlights.cn: 7 大租房陷阱：假房东、押金纠纷、模糊条款。

highlights.en: Ouwen's Settling Advisor works only with licensed agents and verifies property deeds.
highlights.cn: 欧闻「安家顾问」只对接持牌中介，并核验房产证。

highlights.en: Every clause of the contract is walked through with you before signing.
highlights.cn: 签约前逐条陪你过合同。

tip.en: Never pay a deposit or rent to a personal account before verifying the deed and the landlord's identity.
tip.cn: 核实房产证与房东身份前，切勿向个人账户支付押金或租金。

calendar.title: Visa renewal & extension — don't miss the deadline.
calendar.title_cn: 签证续签延期——别错过期限
calendar.pain: Complex renewal/extension timelines; risk of overstay.
calendar.pain_cn: 续签/延期流程复杂，存在逾期风险。

highlights.en: Renewal and extension timelines are easy to miss — and overstaying is a serious offence.

tip.cn: 拿到许可的那一刻就设好日历提醒——30 天的窗口比你想象中过得快。

calendar.title: Pay everywhere with one phone.
calendar.title_cn: 一部手机走天下

calendar.pain_cn: 很多商户只收微信/支付宝，现金很不方便。

tip.cn: 备一小笔数字人民币余额兜底——个别商户或老终端对外卡支持不稳定。

calendar.title: See a doctor without the language barrier.
calendar.title_cn: 看病无障碍

calendar.pain_cn: 预约难、与医生沟通难、买药难。

calendar.title: Make real friends, not just contacts.
calendar.title_cn: 交真朋友，而不只是联系人
calendar.pain: No local circle; culture shock; loneliness.
calendar.pain_cn: 没有本地圈子；文化冲击；孤独感。
calendar.solution: Moving abroad is lonely until you build a real circle. highlights.en: A real local circle beats a long contact list for beating culture shock.
highlights.cn: 对抗文化冲击，真正的本地圈子胜过一长串联系人。

highlights.en: Ouwen's Community Connector runs cultural events, language-exchange corners and interest clubs.
highlights.cn: 欧闻「社群连接器」组织文化活动、语言角与兴趣俱乐部。

highlights.cn: 骑行、美食俱乐部加外籍社群论坛，让孤独感无处可藏。

facts.cn: 兴趣俱乐部：骑行、美食等

tip.en: Commit to one recurring meetup per week — consistency, not intensity, is what builds real friendships.
tip.cn: 每周坚持参加一个固定聚会——交朋友靠的是持续，不是一时热情。

calendar.title: What (and where) to eat in Hainan.
calendar.title_cn: 在海南吃什么、去哪吃
calendar.pain: Unfamiliar with local food and dining etiquette.
calendar.pain_cn: 不熟悉本地美食与用餐礼仪。
calendar.solution: Hainan's food is one of the best parts of living here — light, fresh, and famous for Wenchang chicken, Hainan noodles and tropical fruit. calendar.solution_cn: 海南美食是住在这里的一大乐趣——清淡、新鲜，以文昌鸡、海南粉和热带水果闻名。关键是知道本地人真正去哪吃、以及如何点餐。欧闻提供精选美食指南、在合作餐厅安排双语菜单，并组织美食之旅，让你自信地尝遍全岛——包括符合各种饮食禁忌的菜品。

highlights.cn: 精选美食指南告诉你吃什么、去哪吃——不再踩游客陷阱。

highlights.cn: 合作餐厅提供双语菜单，点餐无障碍。

highlights.cn: 美食导览带你尝本地风味，并讲解用餐礼仪。

tip.cn: 聊起海南四大名菜「文昌鸡、和乐蟹、嘉积鸭、东山羊」，本地人会立刻热情起来。

calendar.title: Duty-free shopping: how to actually use it.

highlights.cn: 欧闻提供分步免税指南与额度计算器。

highlights.en: Partner store discounts stack on top of the official quota.
highlights.cn: 合作门店折扣叠加在官方额度之上。

tip.cn: 随身带好护照与离岛票据——提货免税商品时两者都要核验。

calendar.title: Health insurance: what foreigners actually need.
calendar.title_cn: 医疗保险：外国人真正需要什么
calendar.pain: Unclear what commercial/accident insurance to buy.
calendar.pain_cn: 不清楚该买什么商业/意外保险。

calendar.solution_cn: 你在本国的医疗保险通常不覆盖中国，而你需要一份能在医院直接结算、而非事后报销的计划。欧闻带你了解国际医疗保险选项、为你推荐支持直付的医院，并确保你的保单覆盖核心项目——门诊、住院、急诊和药品——让健康问题永远不会演变成财务问题。

highlights.en: Which commercial/accident insurance to buy is unclear for most foreigners.
highlights.cn: 该买哪种商业/意外险，多数外国人心里没底。

highlights.en: Ouwen guides you on international medical insurance and direct-bill hospitals.
highlights.cn: 欧闻指导你选择国际医疗保险与直付医院。

highlights.en: Essential coverage is matched to your visa type and lifestyle.
highlights.cn: 按你的签证类型与生活方式匹配必要保障。

tip.cn: 确认医院是否「直付」——这决定了是免现金就医，还是先垫付再报销。

calendar.title: Driving in Hainan with a foreign license.

highlights.en: Ouwen assists with temporary driving permits and local traffic rules in English.
highlights.cn: 欧闻协助办理临时驾驶许可，并用英文讲解本地交规。

highlights.en: Rental partners are vetted so you get a road-ready car fast.
highlights.cn: 租车伙伴经过筛选，让你快速开上合规车辆。

tip.cn: 出发前办好驾照官方翻译件——能显著加快临时许可办理。

calendar.title: Register a company in Hainan — the smart way.

calendar.pain: Company registration, tax, social security, legal — high cost and complexity.

highlights.cn: 欧闻「企业伙伴」一站搞定：注册 → EF 开户 → 记账报税 → 人才补贴申请。

highlights.en: Hainan's Free Trade Port adds extra incentives worth structuring for.
highlights.cn: 海南自贸港的政策红利值得提前做好架构规划。

calendar.title: 15% tax cap: are you eligible?
calendar.title_cn: 15% 个税封顶：你符合条件吗？
calendar.pain: Unclear how to qualify for the 15% personal income tax incentive.
calendar.pain_cn: 不清楚如何符合 15% 个税优惠。
calendar.solution: Hainan's headline tax perk: a 15% cap on personal income tax for eligible high-level talent and urgently-needed professionals — far below the mainland's top rate. The key test is residency: you generally need to be in Hainan for at least 183 days a year (with at least 90 days actually spent in the province). Ouwen runs the eligibility check for you, helps you structure your time and income to qualify, and files the application so you keep more of what you earn.
calendar.solution_cn: 海南的王牌税收优惠：对符合条件的高层次人才和紧缺人才，个人所得税最高按 15% 封顶——远低于内地的最高税率。关键是居住时间：通常要求每年在海南累计居住满 183 天（其中实际在琼不少于 90 天）。欧闻帮你做资格核查、规划时间与收入结构以符合条件，并代你申报，让你把更多收入留在自己口袋。

highlights.en: The 15% personal income tax cap applies to eligible high-level talent.
highlights.cn: 15% 个税封顶适用于符合条件的高层次人才。

highlights.en: Eligibility: ≥183 days per year in Hainan (with ≥90 actual days in the tax year).
highlights.cn: 条件：在海南累计居住满 183 天（其中年度内在海南实际工作满 90 天）。

highlights.en: Ouwen checks your eligibility and helps you structure and file.
highlights.cn: 欧闻核查你的资格，并协助架构与申报。

tip.en: Track your Hainan residence days from day one — the 183-day test is decided by records, not memory.
tip.cn: 从第一天起记录在琼天数——183 天的认定靠的是记录，不是记忆。

calendar.title: International schools: pick the right one.
calendar.title_cn: 国际学校：选对的那一所
calendar.pain: Tight seats, complex application, unclear curriculum choices.
calendar.pain_cn: 名额紧张、申请复杂、课程选择不清。
calendar.solution: Choosing the right international school matters for your child's education and your peace of mind, but seats are competitive and applications are complex. Ouwen's 'Education Planning' service compares schools by curriculum (IB, British, American and more), assists with admission applications, interprets the latest policies, and connects you with parent meetups so you can make an informed choice.
calendar.solution_cn: 选对国际学校关系到孩子的教育和你的安心，但名额紧张、申请复杂。欧闻「教育规划」服务按课程体系（IB、英式、美式等）对比各所学校、协助入学申请、解读最新政策，并引荐家长见面会，让你做出明智选择。

highlights.en: International school seats are tight and admissions complex.
highlights.cn: 国际学校名额紧张、录取流程复杂。

highlights.en: Ouwen's Education Planning covers school comparison, admission assistance and policy interpretation.
highlights.cn: 欧闻「教育规划」涵盖择校对比、入学协助与政策解读。

highlights.en: Parent meetups connect you with families who've already navigated it.
highlights.cn: 家长聚会让你认识已经走通这条路的家庭。

facts.cn: 择校 + 入学 + 家长聚会

tip.en: Start admissions 6–12 months early — top international schools in Hainan fill their foreigner quotas fast.
tip.cn: 提前 6–12 个月启动入学——海南优质国际学校的外籍名额很快报满。

calendar.title: Buying property as a foreigner — the rules.
calendar.title_cn: 外国人买房——规则是什么
calendar.pain: Special purchase policy, complex process, legal/tax issues.
calendar.pain_cn: 购房政策特殊、流程复杂、有法律税务问题。
calendar.solution: Buying property in China as a foreigner is possible but tightly regulated — you must have lived in China for at least a year, and each purchase needs review. The process involves deed verification, contracts, taxes and financing, all in Chinese. Ouwen's 'Settling Advisor' works with compliant agents, interprets the purchase and rental policies, and accompanies you through the transaction so every step is above board.
calendar.solution_cn: 外国人在中国购房是可以的，但受到严格监管——通常须在中国连续居留满一年，且每笔交易都需审核。流程涉及房产核实、合同、税费与融资，全程中文。欧闻「安居顾问」对接合规中介、解读购房与租房政策，并全程陪同交易，确保每一步都合法合规。

highlights.en: Foreigners buying property face special purchase policy and legal/tax complexity.
highlights.cn: 外国人购房适用特殊政策，涉及法律与税务复杂性。

highlights.en: Ouwen's Settling Advisor works with compliant agents and interprets purchase/rent policy.
highlights.cn: 欧闻「安家顾问」对接合规中介，解读买卖与租赁政策。

highlights.en: Transaction accompaniment covers due diligence through closing.
highlights.cn: 交易陪同覆盖从尽调到过户全程。

facts.cn: 合规中介 + 交易陪同

tip.en: Verify the developer's five permits and the land-use rights before any deposit — this is the single most important check.
tip.cn: 交任何定金前，先核实开发商的「五证」与土地使用权——这是最重要的一项核查。

calendar.title: Send money home, the compliant way.
calendar.title_cn: 合规地把钱汇回家
calendar.pain: Cross-border salary repatriation and asset management face FX controls.
calendar.pain_cn: 跨境工资汇回与资产管理受外汇管制。
calendar.solution: Getting your salary and savings home is one of the biggest worries for foreign professionals, given China's foreign-exchange controls. Hainan's EF-account system gives eligible residents a compliant channel to hold foreign currency and move funds. Ouwen's 'Cross-border Finance Bridge' sets up your EF account, explains the legal salary-repatriation process, and helps with small-amount instant FX swaps — so your money flows home smoothly and within the rules.
calendar.solution_cn: 在外汇管制下，把工资和积蓄汇回家是外籍人士最担心的问题之一。海南的 EF 账户体系为符合条件的居民提供了合规持有外币、调动资金的渠道。欧闻「跨境金融桥梁」帮你开立 EF 账户、讲解合法的工资汇回流程，并协助小额即时外汇兑换——让你的资金顺畅、合规地汇回家。

highlights.en: Small-amount instant FX swap covers your day-to-day needs.

tip.en: Keep your employment contract and tax records — they are the documents that prove legitimate income for compliant remittance.
tip.cn: 保留劳动合同与完税记录——这是证明收入合规、顺利汇出的关键材料。

calendar.title: Bring your family to Hainan.
calendar.title_cn: 把家人带到海南
calendar.pain: Family reunification visas and dependents' status are confusing.
calendar.pain_cn: 家庭团聚签证与家属身份令人困惑。
calendar.solution: You shouldn't have to choose between your career and your family. If you hold a valid work or residence permit in Hainan, your spouse, parents and children can generally join you — through Q1/Q2 residence permits for family reunification, or as dependents on your own permit. Ouwen prepares the relationship documents (often needing notarisation and legalisation), files the applications, and gets your family settled beside you.
calendar.solution_cn: 你不必在事业和家庭之间二选一。若你在海南持有有效的工作或居留许可，你的配偶、父母和子女通常可以随行——通过 Q1/Q2 家庭团聚居留许可，或作为你许可的随行家属。欧闻准备亲属关系证明（通常需公证与认证）、递交申请，让你的家人来到你身边安顿。

highlights.en: Family reunification visas and dependents' status are confusing.
highlights.cn: 家庭团聚签证与随行家属身份令人困惑。

highlights.en: Q1/Q2 residence permits cover spouse, parents and children.
highlights.cn: Q1/Q2 居留许可覆盖配偶、父母、子女。

highlights.en: Dependents can join your work/residence permit.
highlights.cn: 家属可随你的工作/居留许可一同办理。

tip.en: Prepare notarised and authenticated relationship certificates (marriage/birth) in advance — they are the most common missing piece.
tip.cn: 提前办妥经公证认证的关系证明（结婚/出生）——这是最常缺失的材料。

calendar.title: From visitor to permanent resident — the roadmap.
calendar.title_cn: 从访客到永居——完整路线图
calendar.pain: No clear long-term path from first landing to permanent residency.
calendar.pain_cn: 从首次入境到永久居留，没有清晰的长远路径。
calendar.solution: Most people land in Hainan with no idea how to get from 'first entry' to 'permanent resident'. The path actually exists, step by step: settle in with a residence permit → work and build a record → earn high-level talent status → become eligible for permanent residence after meeting residency and contribution thresholds. Ouwen maps your personalised long-term roadmap and reviews it with you at each milestone, so every year moves you closer to calling Hainan home for good.
calendar.solution_cn: 大多数人落地海南时，完全不清楚如何从「首次入境」走到「永久居留」。其实这条路是一步一步走出来的：持居留许可安家 → 工作并积累记录 → 取得高层次人才身份 → 满足居住与贡献门槛后获得永居资格。欧闻为你绘制个性化长远路线图，并在每个里程碑陪你复盘，让你每一年都更接近把海南当作永远的家。

highlights.en: No clear long-term path from first landing to permanent residency.
highlights.cn: 从落地到永居之间缺乏清晰的长期路径。

highlights.en: The roadmap: residence → work permit → talent status → permanent residence eligibility.
highlights.cn: 路线图：居留 → 工作许可 → 人才身份 → 永居资格。

highlights.en: Owen builds a personalised long-term plan for your situation.
highlights.cn: 欧闻为你量身定制长期规划。

facts.cn: 通往永居的 4 步路线图

tip.en: Permanent residence is a marathon, not a sprint — each earlier step (talent certification, tax records) compounds later.
tip.cn: 永居是马拉松而非冲刺——早先每一步（人才认定、完税记录）都会在后期叠加优势。

calendar.title: Medicines & vaccinations: pack smart before you fly
calendar.title_cn: 药品与疫苗：起飞前聪明打包
calendar.pain: Unsure which medicines you can bring into China, and whether you need vaccinations or health documents.
calendar.pain_cn: 不确定哪些药品能带入中国，是否需要疫苗或健康证明。
calendar.solution: Packing medicine for China needs a little preparation. For your personal prescription medications, carry a doctor's note and a copy of the prescription (in English or Chinese), and bring only quantities for personal use during your stay. Certain medicines are controlled in China and must be declared at customs, so check the list before you fly. On vaccinations, there's no mandatory shot for entry, but Ouwen recommends confirming with a travel clinic which vaccines suit your itinerary. Our pre-trip health checklist walks you through every step so nothing gets confiscated or delayed.
calendar.solution_cn: 带药入境中国需要一点准备。个人处方药请随身携带医生证明和处方复印件（英文或中文），且只带停留期间自用所需的量。部分药品在中国属于管制物品，须在海关申报，所以起飞前先核对清单。疫苗方面，入境并无强制接种，但欧闻建议你向旅行门诊确认适合行程的疫苗。我们的行前健康清单带你走完每一步，确保药品不被没收、行程不被延误。

highlights.en: Carry a doctor's note and the original prescription for personal medicines.
highlights.cn: 个人药品随身携带医生证明和原始处方。

highlights.en: Controlled or restricted items must be declared at customs on entry.
highlights.cn: 受控/受限物品须在入境时向海关申报。

highlights.en: Confirm recommended vaccinations for your itinerary before departure.
highlights.cn: 出发前确认行程所需的推荐疫苗。

facts.cn: 个人药品 = 医生证明 + 处方

tip.en: Keep medicines in their original labelled packaging and carry only the quantity needed for your trip — bulk unlabelled pills invite customs questions.
tip.cn: 药品保留原厂标签包装，只带行程所需用量——散装无标签药片最容易引来海关问询。

calendar.title: Don't forget the medical check for your residence permit
calendar.title_cn: 办居留许可，别忘了体检
calendar.pain: Your work or residence permit application stalls because you didn't complete the required physical examination at a designated hospital.
calendar.pain_cn: 工作或居留许可申请卡住，因为你没在指定医院完成必需的体检。
calendar.solution: Your residence or work permit won't be issued without an approved medical check — and it must be done at a designated hospital, not your family doctor. The standard package covers a physical exam, blood tests and a chest X-ray, and the result is sealed in an official 'Foreigner Physical Examination Record'. Ouwen books your appointment at the designated International Travel Healthcare Center, walks you through each item, and makes sure the sealed record reaches the authorities on time — so your application never stalls.
calendar.solution_cn: 没有通过指定医院的体检，你的居留或工作许可就无法签发——而且必须在指定医院做，不能找家庭医生。标准项目包括体格检查、血液检测和胸片，结果会密封在官方《外国人体格检查记录》中。欧闻帮你预约指定国际旅行卫生保健中心、逐项陪同体检，并确保密封记录按时送达相关部门——让你的申请绝不卡壳。

highlights.en: Your work or residence permit stalls without the required physical exam at a designated hospital.
highlights.cn: 缺了指定医院的体检，工作/居留许可申请会卡住。

highlights.en: The exam must be done at an International Travel Healthcare Center.
highlights.cn: 体检须在国际旅行卫生保健中心进行。

highlights.en: Ouwen books the appointment, walks you through each item and delivers the sealed record on time.
highlights.cn: 欧闻代约、逐项陪同，并按时送达密封的《外国人体格检查记录》。

facts.cn: 密封《外国人体格检查记录》

tip.en: Do the medical check early — it is a common last-minute blocker that can push your whole application back.
tip.cn: 体检要趁早——这是最容易临门一脚卡住的环节，会拖慢整个申请。

calendar.title: Typhoon season: read the warning signals & stay safe
calendar.title_cn: 台风季：读懂预警信号、安全避险
calendar.pain: Typhoons hit Hainan often in summer and autumn, and foreigners don't know what the colored warning signals mean or how to prepare.
calendar.pain_cn: 海南夏秋台风频繁，外籍人士看不懂蓝/黄/橙/红预警信号的含义，也不知道如何防范。
calendar.solution: Hainan's summer and autumn typhoon season is something every resident learns to read. The warning system uses four colours — blue, yellow, orange, red — each signalling stronger wind and stricter precautions. Orange and red mean stay indoors and stock up. Ouwen sends you bilingual typhoon alerts and a step-by-step safety checklist: what each colour means, what supplies to keep (water, food, power banks, medicines), and exactly when to stay put — so you're never caught off guard.
calendar.solution_cn: 海南夏秋的台风季是每位居民都要学会看懂的。预警系统用四种颜色——蓝、黄、橙、红——每级代表更强的风力和更严格的防范要求。橙色和红色意味着要留在室内并储备物资。欧闻为你推送双语台风预警和分步安全清单：每级颜色代表什么、该储备哪些物资（水、食物、充电宝、药品）、以及何时必须留在室内——让你永远不被打个措手不及。

source.name: Hainan Provincial Government — Emergency Management
source.name_cn: 海南省政府 — 应急管理

highlights.en: Typhoons hit Hainan often in summer and autumn — foreigners don't know the colour signals.
highlights.cn: 夏秋海南台风多发——外国人看不懂颜色预警信号。

highlights.en: Each colour (blue/yellow/orange/red) signals a different threat level and action.
highlights.cn: 蓝/黄/橙/红四级预警对应不同危险等级与应对措施。

highlights.en: Ouwen sends bilingual typhoon alerts with a step-by-step safety checklist.
highlights.cn: 欧闻推送双语台风预警与分步避险清单。

facts.en: 4 warning levels: blue / yellow / orange / red

tip.en: Stock water, food and a power bank when an orange signal is issued — and stay indoors for red.
tip.cn: 发布橙色预警时备好水、食物和充电宝——红色预警则务必待在室内。

calendar.title: Corporate income tax at 15%: does your business qualify?
calendar.title_cn: 企业所得税 15%：你的企业符合条件吗？
calendar.pain: Entrepreneurs don't know whether their business falls under Hainan's 'encouraged industries' and can pay only 15% corporate income tax instead of the standard 25%.
calendar.pain_cn: 创业者不清楚自己的企业是否属于海南「鼓励类产业」，能否只缴 15% 企业所得税（而非标准 25%）。
calendar.solution: If your business qualifies as an 'encouraged industry' in Hainan, your corporate income tax drops from the standard 25% to 15% — a huge saving. The test is two-fold: your business activity must fall within the encouraged-industries catalogue, and the company must be substantively operated in Hainan (real staff, real premises, real business). Ouwen checks your business scope against the catalogue, confirms you meet the substantive-operation requirement, and helps you file for the 15% rate correctly.
calendar.solution_cn: 如果你的企业属于海南「鼓励类产业」，企业所得税就能从标准的 25% 降到 15%——这是一笔巨大的节省。判断标准有两条：你的经营活动须在鼓励类产业目录内，且企业须在海南实质性运营（有真实员工、真实场所、真实业务）。欧闻对照目录核查你的经营范围、确认你满足实质性运营要求，并协助你正确申报 15% 优惠税率。

highlights.en: Only 'encouraged industries' qualify for the 15% corporate income tax rate (vs standard 25%).
highlights.cn: 只有「鼓励类产业」可享 15% 企业所得税（标准为 25%）。

highlights.en: A substantive-operation requirement must be met in Hainan.
highlights.cn: 须满足在海南实质经营的要求。

highlights.en: Owen checks your business scope against the catalogue and helps you file.
highlights.cn: 欧闻对照目录核查你的经营范围，并协助申报。

tip.en: The 'substantive operation' test looks at staff, premises and management in Hainan — structure this early, not after the fact.
tip.cn: 「实质经营」要看在琼的人员、场所与管理——要尽早规划，而非事后补救。

calendar.title: Cash & customs: what you must declare when entering Hainan
calendar.title_cn: 现金与海关：入境海南必须申报什么
calendar.pain: Foreigners don't know the cash limits and which items must be declared at Chinese customs, risking fines or confiscation.
calendar.pain_cn: 外籍人士不清楚入境现金限额和哪些物品必须向海关申报，有被罚款或没收的风险。
calendar.solution: Chinese customs has clear rules on cash and goods, and knowing them before you fly saves you from fines or confiscation. Bring RMB cash of ¥20,000 or more, or foreign currency of USD 5,000 or more, and you must declare it. At the airport, you'll choose between the green ('nothing to declare') and red ('goods to declare') channels — pick the right one, because wrongly choosing green is treated as an offence. Ouwen's pre-flight customs checklist covers the limits, what counts as declarable, and how the red/green channels work, so you breeze through customs legally.
calendar.solution_cn: 中国海关对现金和物品有明确规定，起飞前了解能帮你避免罚款或没收。携带人民币现金 2 万元及以上、或外币 5000 美元及以上，就必须申报。在机场你会选择绿色（无申报物品）或红色（有申报物品）通道——务必选对，因为错选绿通道会被视为违规。欧闻的行前海关清单涵盖限额、哪些物品需申报、以及红绿通道如何使用，让你合法顺畅通关。

highlights.en: Declare RMB cash of ¥20,000 or more on entry/exit.
highlights.cn: 携带人民币现金 ≥2 万元须申报。

highlights.en: Declare foreign currency of USD 5,000 or more (or equivalent).
highlights.cn: 携带外币 ≥5000 美元（或等值）须申报。

highlights.en: Know the red (goods to declare) and green (nothing to declare) channel rules before you board.
highlights.cn: 登机前搞清红色（申报）与绿色（无申报）通道规则。

facts.cn: 人民币现金申报线 2 万元

tip.en: Undisclosed cash over the limit risks fines or confiscation — declare at the red channel and keep the receipt.
tip.cn: 超额现金不申报有罚款或没收风险——走红色通道主动申报并保留凭证。

calendar.title: Z visa in hand? Swap it for a residence permit within 30 days.
calendar.title_cn: Z 签已到手？30 天内换成居留许可
calendar.pain: You entered on a Z visa but don't realize it must be converted into a residence permit within 30 days of entry — miss the window and you're overstaying.
calendar.pain_cn: 你持 Z 签入境，却不知道必须在入境 30 天内把它换成居留许可——错过期限就属于逾期滞留。
calendar.solution: A Z visa only lets you enter — it does not let you stay long-term. By law, you must convert it into a residence permit within 30 days of entering China, and missing that window means you're technically overstaying. Ouwen books your Exit-Entry Administration appointment, assembles the full dossier — work permit card, sealed medical record, housing registration — and follows through until your residence permit is issued before the deadline, so there's no gap and no risk.
calendar.solution_cn: Z 签证只允许你入境，并不能让你长期停留。按法律规定，你须在入境后 30 天内把它换成居留许可，错过这个窗口就意味着你事实上已逾期滞留。欧闻帮你预约出入境管理局、备齐全套材料——工作许可证、密封体检记录、住宿登记——并跟进直到居留许可在期限内签发，确保没有空档、没有风险。

highlights.en: A Z visa must be converted into a residence permit within 30 days of entry.
highlights.cn: Z 字签证须在入境后 30 天内换发居留许可。

highlights.en: Miss the 30-day window and you are effectively overstaying.
highlights.cn: 错过 30 天窗口，就相当于逾期居留。

highlights.en: Ouwen books your Exit-Entry Administration appointment and prepares the full dossier.
highlights.cn: 欧闻代约出入境管理局，备齐完整材料。

tip.en: Book your appointment the week you land — popular offices fill up fast and the clock is already running.
tip.cn: 落地当周就约号——热门窗口号源紧张，而倒计时早已开始。

calendar.title: Ride the island-loop high-speed rail: 3 hours, 653 km, one ticket.
calendar.title_cn: 坐环岛高铁：3 小时、653 公里、一张票
calendar.pain: Foreigners don't realize Hainan has a high-speed rail loop linking Haikou, Sanya and every major city, so they overpay for taxis or flights just to cross the island.
calendar.pain_cn: 外籍人士不知道海南有一条环岛高铁连接海口、三亚等各大城市，结果只能花高价打车或坐飞机跨岛。
calendar.solution: Hainan's island-loop high-speed rail is the smartest way to see the province: 653 km of track linking Haikou, Sanya and the major coastal cities, with the full loop taking about 3 hours. You can buy tickets with a foreign passport, and stations have English signage. Ouwen's transport guide shows you how to book tickets, read the route maps (Haikou East, Sanya and the stops between), and pick which stretch of the island to explore on a day trip.
calendar.solution_cn: 海南环岛高铁是游览全省最聪明的方式：653 公里轨道连接海口、三亚和主要沿海城市，环岛全程约 3 小时。你可用外国护照购票，车站都有英文标识。欧闻的出行指南教你如何购票、看懂线路图（海口东、三亚及沿途站点），并推荐适合一日游的环岛路段。

highlights.en: Hainan has a high-speed rail loop linking Haikou, Sanya and every major city.
highlights.cn: 海南环岛高铁串起海口、三亚及各主要城市。

highlights.en: The full loop is about 653 km and roughly 3 hours — one ticket goes a long way.
highlights.cn: 环岛全程约 653 公里、约 3 小时——一张票走很长的路。

highlights.en: Book with a foreign passport via the official app or station counters.
highlights.cn: 用外国护照可通过官方 App 或车站窗口购票。

tip.en: Skip taxis and flights for island hops — the high-speed rail is usually faster, cheaper and smoother.
tip.cn: 岛内出行别选打车或飞机——高铁通常更快、更便宜、更平稳。

calendar.title: Get certified as a Hainan high-level talent (A/B/C) — and unlock real perks
calendar.title_cn: 认定海南高层次人才（A/B/C 类）——解锁真福利
calendar.pain: Foreign professionals don't know they can be certified as Hainan high-level talent, so they miss out on housing subsidies, tax incentives, and school-priority perks.
calendar.pain_cn: 外籍专业人士不知道自己能认定海南高层次人才，白白错过住房补贴、税收优惠和子女入学优先等福利。
calendar.solution: Hainan certifies high-level talent in three tiers — A, B and C — and certification unlocks real, concrete perks: housing subsidies, the 15% income-tax cap, priority school admission for your children, and more. Eligibility is judged against an official classification catalogue by your qualifications, achievements and field. Ouwen checks your profile against the A/B/C catalogue, files the talent certification on your behalf, and helps you claim every matching benefit, so your status is recognised and your perks actually arrive.
calendar.solution_cn: 海南把高层次人才分为 A、B、C 三个层级，认定后能解锁实实在在的福利：住房补贴、15% 个税封顶、子女入学优先等。是否达标依据官方分类目录，看你的资历、成就和领域。欧闻对照 A/B/C 目录核查你的情况、代你递交人才认定申请，并协助你申领每项匹配福利，让你的身份被认可、福利真正落地。

calendar.title: Bringing your pet to Hainan? Start the paperwork 30+ days early.
calendar.title_cn: 带宠物来海南？至少提前 30 天备材料
calendar.pain: Foreigners relocating with a dog or cat don't realize China requires an ISO microchip, an up-to-date rabies vaccine, and an official health certificate, plus entry through a designated port — or their pet gets quarantined.
calendar.pain_cn: 带猫狗来琼的外籍人士不知道中国要求 ISO 芯片、有效狂犬疫苗和官方健康证明，且须从指定口岸入境——否则宠物会被隔离。
calendar.solution: Bringing a dog or cat to Hainan takes planning — start at least 30 days early. China requires your pet to have an ISO-standard microchip, an up-to-date rabies vaccination, and an official health certificate from your home country's authority, and the pet must enter through a designated port, otherwise it faces quarantine. Ouwen's pet-arrival checklist maps every requirement by your origin country, tells you which ports accept pets, and prepares the full certificate pack before you fly, so your companion clears customs without quarantine.
calendar.solution_cn: 带猫狗来海南需要提前规划——至少提前 30 天开始。中国要求宠物植入 ISO 标准芯片、接种有效的狂犬疫苗、并持有原籍国官方出具的动物健康证明，且须从指定口岸入境，否则会被隔离。欧闻的宠物入境清单按你的来源国逐项列出要求、告知哪些口岸可携宠入境，并在起飞前备齐全套证明，让你的伙伴无需隔离就能顺利通关。

highlights.en: China requires an ISO-standard microchip, an up-to-date rabies vaccine and an official health certificate.
highlights.cn: 中国要求 ISO 标准芯片、有效狂犬疫苗和官方健康证明。

highlights.en: Pets must enter through a designated port — or face quarantine.
highlights.cn: 宠物须从指定口岸入境——否则会被隔离。

highlights.en: Start the paperwork 30+ days early; requirements vary by origin country.
highlights.cn: 至少提前 30 天备材料；不同来源国要求不同。

facts.cn: 三大要件：ISO 芯片 + 狂犬疫苗 + 健康证明

calendar.title: Your employment injury insurance starts on Day 1 — even during probation.
calendar.title_cn: 工伤保险入职第一天就生效——试用期也算
calendar.pain: Foreigners working in Hainan don't know they are entitled to social insurance from their first work day, and assume their employer handles everything automatically.
calendar.pain_cn: 在海南工作的外籍人士不知道从第一天起就享有社会保险，以为雇主会自动办理。
calendar.solution: From your very first work day — including the probation period — your employer is legally required to enroll you in Hainan's social insurance, which covers five types: pension, medical, unemployment, work-injury and maternity. Don't assume it's automatic; many employers miss the 30-day registration window. Ouwen walks you through the five-insurance system, explains your employer's obligations, and shows you how to verify your own coverage online so you're protected from day one.

calendar.title: Garbage sorting in Hainan: the 4 bins you must learn
calendar.title_cn: 海南垃圾分类：必须学会的 4 类垃圾桶
calendar.pain: Haikou, Sanya and other cities now enforce mandatory household waste sorting with fines, but most foreigners don't know the four categories (recyclable, kitchen, hazardous, other) or their district's rules.
calendar.pain_cn: 海口、三亚等城市已强制实行生活垃圾分类并设有罚款，但多数外籍人士不清楚四分类（可回收、厨余、有害、其他）和所在区的规定。
calendar.solution: Haikou, Sanya and other Hainan cities now enforce mandatory household waste sorting, with fines for non-compliance — and the system uses four bins: recyclable, kitchen (food) waste, hazardous, and other. Each district has its own schedule and slight rule differences. Ouwen gives you a bilingual sorting chart, explains which bin every common item belongs in, and provides a neighbourhood guide with your district's collection schedule — so you sort correctly and never risk a fine.
calendar.solution_cn: 海口、三亚等海南城市现已强制实行生活垃圾四分类——可回收、厨余、有害、其他——违规会被罚款，且每个区的收运时间和细则略有不同。欧闻给你一份双语分类表、讲解每样常见垃圾该扔哪个桶，并提供你所在社区的收运指南——让你正确分类，从此不再担心被罚款。

highlights.en: Haikou, Sanya and other cities enforce mandatory waste sorting with fines.
highlights.cn: 海口、三亚等城市强制垃圾分类，违规有罚款。

highlights.en: The four categories: recyclable, kitchen, hazardous and other.
highlights.cn: 四类：可回收物、厨余垃圾、有害垃圾、其他垃圾。

tip.cn: 电池、灯泡属有害垃圾而非「其他」——这是最容易吃罚单的错误。

calendar.title: Annual tax settlement: don't miss the March–June filing window
calendar.title_cn: 个税年度汇算：别错过 3–6 月申报期
calendar.pain: Foreign residents often don't realize they must file an annual individual income tax reconciliation in China — or that it's the same window where Hainan's 15% incentive gets applied.
calendar.pain_cn: 外籍居民往往不知道中国需要办理个税年度汇算，更不知道这正是海南 15% 优惠落地的同一窗口。
calendar.solution: Every tax-resident in China should file an annual individual income tax reconciliation — and for foreign residents, this is also the exact window where Hainan's 15% incentive gets applied and any overpaid tax gets refunded. The filing period runs from March to June each year. Ouwen reminds you every March, helps determine your resident or non-resident status, and completes the annual settlement with you — applying the 15% Hainan rate wherever you qualify, so you don't miss a refund or a saving.
calendar.solution_cn: 中国的每位税务居民都应办理个税年度汇算——对外籍居民而言，这正是海南 15% 优惠落地、多缴税款退税的同一窗口。申报期为每年 3 月至 6 月。欧闻每年 3 月提醒你、协助判定居民/非居民纳税身份，并陪你完成年度汇算——在符合条件处适用海南 15% 优惠税率，让你不错过任何退税或优惠。

highlights.en: Foreign residents must file an annual individual income tax reconciliation in China.
highlights.cn: 外籍居民须在中国办理个税年度汇算。

highlights.en: The March–June window is also when Hainan's 15% incentive gets applied.
highlights.cn: 3–6 月窗口期也正是海南 15% 优惠落实的时段。

highlights.en: Owen reminds you every March and completes the settlement for you.
highlights.cn: 欧闻每年 3 月提醒，并代你完成汇算。

tip.en: Mark March in your calendar every year — missing the annual settlement can mean penalties and a lost 15% refund.
tip.cn: 每年在日历上标记 3 月——错过年度汇算可能面临滞纳金，还错失 15% 退税。

calendar.title: Book smart: the new flight-tax refund most visitors miss.
calendar.title_cn: 聪明购票：大多数访客不知道的国际航班离境退税
calendar.pain: Foreign travellers don't know they can claim back value-added tax on plane tickets purchased in China — and that Hainan has its own additional refund scheme for island-bound flights.
calendar.pain_cn: 外籍旅客不知道可以申请中国境内购买的机票增值税退税，也不知道海南还有针对离岛航班的地方退税政策。
calendar.solution: Most visitors never realise they can reclaim tax on flights booked within China. If you're leaving on an international flight, you may claim back VAT on your air ticket, with a cap of CNY 100,000 — and Hainan adds its own island-departure refund scheme on top for qualifying island-bound travel. The catch is you must know the rules and which airlines participate. Ouwen walks you through the VAT-refund cap, checks your eligibility for Hainan's extra refund, and tells you which airlines and routes qualify, so you book smart and keep the saving.
calendar.solution_cn: 大多数访客都不知道，在中国境内购买的机票可以退税。若你乘坐国际航班离境，可申请退回机票增值税，上限为 10 万元人民币——海南还在此基础上叠加了针对符合条件的离岛行程的地方退税政策。关键是你要懂规则、知道哪些航司参与。欧闻带你了解退税额度、核查你是否符合海南额外退税条件，并告诉你哪些航司和航线适用，让你聪明购票、把优惠留下。

highlights.en: International flight tickets bought in China are eligible for VAT refund (up to a CNY 100,000 cap).
highlights.cn: 在中国境内购买的国际机票可申请增值税退税（上限 10 万元）。

highlights.en: Hainan adds its own island-departure tax-refund scheme for eligible flights.
highlights.cn: 海南另有离岛退税政策，适用于符合条件的航班。

highlights.en: Not all airlines participate — check before booking.
highlights.cn: 并非所有航司都参与——购票前先确认。

facts.en: CNY 100,000 VAT-refund cap for international flights
facts.cn: 国际航班增值税退税上限 10 万元

tip.en: Keep your e-ticket itinerary/receipt and boarding pass — both are usually required to claim the refund.
tip.cn: 保留电子行程单和登机牌——申请退税时通常两者都需要。

calendar.title: Moved in? Set up water, power, gas & internet the right way.
calendar.title_cn: 搬进新家？正确开通水电气与网络
calendar.pain: After signing a lease, most foreigners don't know how to transfer utility accounts into their name, read the tiered electricity bills, or pay without a local bank card.
calendar.pain_cn: 签完租房合同后，多数外籍人士不知道如何把水电燃气账户过户到自己名下、看懂阶梯电价账单，或没有本地银行卡该如何缴费。

calendar.title: Zero-tariff inputs + 30% value-add rule: Hainan's factory bonus
calendar.title_cn: 零关税原料 + 加工增值 30% 规则：海南制造红利
calendar.pain: Entrepreneurs don't know Hainan Free Trade Port lets manufacturers import machinery and raw materials duty-free, and that products with over 30% local value-add re-enter the domestic market tariff-free.
calendar.pain_cn: 创业者不知道海南自贸港允许制造企业零关税进口设备与原料，且加工增值超 30% 的产品可免税销往内地市场。
calendar.solution: Hainan Free Trade Port hands manufacturers a powerful edge: import machinery and raw materials duty-free, then — if your finished product has more than 30% value added within Hainan — sell it into the mainland domestic market with zero tariff. The key is getting the value-add calculation right and completing the required customs recordation. Ouwen checks your business against the zero-tariff positive list, confirms your 30% value-add calculation, and files the customs recordation, so you import duty-free from day one and unlock the mainland market.
calendar.solution_cn: 海南自贸港为制造企业提供了强大优势：零关税进口设备与原料，若成品在海南加工增值超过 30%，还能零关税销往内地市场。关键是算对增值额并完成海关备案。欧闻对照零关税正面清单核查你的业务、确认 30% 增值额计算，并代办海关备案，让你从第一天起零关税进口、打开内地市场。

highlights.en: Hainan Free Trade Port lets manufacturers import machinery and raw materials duty-free.
highlights.cn: 海南自贸港允许制造企业免税进口机器设备与原材料。

highlights.en: Products with over 30% local value-add re-enter the domestic market tariff-free.
highlights.cn: 加工增值超过 30% 的产品，可免税销往内地市场。

highlights.en: Owen checks your business against the zero-tariff positive list and files the customs recordation.
highlights.cn: 欧闻对照零关税正面清单核查，并代办海关备案。

tip.en: The 30% value-add calculation is technical — get it right at the customs recordation stage, not during an audit.
tip.cn: 30% 增值的计算很专业——要在海关备案阶段就做对，而不是等稽查时才补救。

calendar.title: Fill out your China entry health declaration before you board
calendar.title_cn: 登机前填好中国入境健康申报
calendar.pain: Many travellers arrive at the Hainan border without completing China's mandatory entry health declaration, causing delays at the checkpoint or being pulled aside to fill it out on the spot.
calendar.pain_cn: 不少旅客抵达海南口岸才发现没填中国入境健康申报，在边检排队或被要求现场补填。
calendar.solution: China requires every inbound traveller to complete an entry health declaration, and finishing it before you board saves you from queues and being pulled aside at the border. The easiest way is the 'Customs Pocket Declaration' WeChat mini-program (there's also a paper form and a website), where you fill in your passport, flight and health details, then save the QR code. Ouwen's pre-flight checklist walks you through each field, shows you how to save the QR code, and reminds you to present it on arrival — so you step off the plane ready to clear customs fast.
calendar.solution_cn: 中国要求每位入境旅客完成入境健康申报，登机前填好能帮你避开排队和入境时被单独拦下。最方便的方式是通过「海关旅客指尖服务」微信小程序（也有纸质版和网页版），填写护照、航班和健康信息后保存二维码。欧闻的行前清单带你逐项填写、教你保存二维码，并提醒你入境时出示——让你一下飞机就能快速通关。

highlights.en: Complete China's entry health declaration via the 'Customs Pocket Declaration' (海关旅客指尖服务) WeChat mini-program before you board.
highlights.cn: 登机前通过「海关旅客指尖服务」微信小程序完成入境健康申报。

highlights.en: Alternatively use the web portal htdecl.chinaport.gov.cn or the China Customs App.
highlights.cn: 也可通过网页 htdecl.chinaport.gov.cn 或中国海关 App 办理。

highlights.en: Save the QR code and present it at customs on arrival.
highlights.cn: 保存二维码，入境时向海关出示。

facts.en: 3 ways to declare: WeChat mini-program / web / App
facts.cn: 3 种申报方式：小程序 / 网页 / App

tip.en: Do it 24 hours before arrival and screenshot the QR code — airport WiFi can be slow, and a saved code gets you through faster.
tip.cn: 抵达前 24 小时内填写并截图保存二维码——机场 WiFi 可能很慢，存好的码能让你更快通关。
